reviewer: Codex: five-language whole-memo lesson and native output review
review_scope: Prepared material and native local execution review. Read the five localized lesson outlines and source sets, all ten artifact cards and run-review notes, five full practice review packages and the demo-specific changed passages. Final package/card text matches the inspected run after temporary-path normalization; the final clarified run notes were read separately. Eighty-eight native advisory and validator checks pass, including ten distinct phase/language review exercises. Native voice, window presentation, human timing, learner comprehension and professional approval remain unverified. The authored fictional review interpretations are regression fixtures outside shipped kits.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: The plain title introduces reviewing an advisory memo. The learner selects the memo, assignment and supporting notes, sees the current pipeline examine the full short document, opens the review, follows a finding to its source and repeats with new evidence. It teaches how to use the whole workflow.
editorial.inputs_and_request: The supplied Ciclo Arco memo recommends immediate daily collection, treats conditional client interest as proven demand and overstates vehicle capacity. Five substantive statements across two paragraphs are available for exact comparison. Assignment and operating notes distinguish the requested pilot comparison, customer preferences, missing bookings and limited Wednesday vehicle availability. The practice adds a later vehicle-unavailability note; no external research, contact or spending is requested.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: Ten distinct native exercises prepare the actual review contract and inventories, retain the unchanged memo and package explicitly authored five-claim, ten-dimension reviews. The learner distinguishes the document from its evidence and traces one material finding to an exact passage and selected local source. Matched support is stated because original drafting provenance is unavailable. Mechanical completeness is kept separate from readiness and truth.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: The concise artifact card leads with the memo not being ready and three useful corrections: compare launch options, accurately report customer statements and correct transport assumptions. It links the full readable review, unchanged original and native records. The full package covers all five substantive statements and gives concrete actions. The booking-sequence finding challenges committing before demand checks without claiming that later bookings are impossible. A separate corrected memo and its own review remain the next step, not an output falsely claimed as completed.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: The unchanged memo is reviewed again with the additional vehicle note. The vehicle statement changes from partial support to contradiction; an unagreed neighbouring-workshop loan is not treated as available transport. Each practice preserves every file of its initial review byte-for-byte and provides a working link to that prior review. The learner explains what must change before the memo can support the owner decision.
editorial.language_and_pacing: Language it. The outline, fictional sources, authored assessments, summary and fixed report navigation are localized. Six planned stages total 390 seconds. The short entry summary and one source comparison keep the first-use path focused while the complete review remains available. Actual elapsed lesson time and learner comprehension have not been measured.

demo.result_review: The actual initial review compares all five memo statements with the assignment and original notes. It identifies unsupported launch advice, overstated demand and limited Wednesday transport. The original is unchanged; the complete review record does not approve the memo.

practice.result_review: A second actual review adds the vehicle-unavailability source to the same unchanged memo, updates the transport finding and keeps readiness not ready. All original-review files remain unchanged and linked. No corrected memo, professional approval, contact, booking or spending is claimed.
